name: navi
description: Interactive cheatsheet tool with fuzzy finding and command templating for terminal workflows

tools.description: Interactive cheatsheet tool with fuzzy search for discovering and executing command templates
tools.usage:
navi # Open interactive fuzzy finder for commands
navi --print # Show command without executing
navi --path /path/to/cheats # Add custom cheatsheet directory
navi widget shell # Install shell integration
navi search docker # Search for docker-related commands
